messages:
Renee: Quick note from the design review of the model catalog compare UI. Two small but recurring confusions: badge semantics and pin scope.
Renee: 1) People read the green "fast" badge as cheaper. 2) Pin action reads as permanent in the tooltip.
Omar: On 1) agree. We should add an explicit axis label (Latency | Throughput | Cost) in the badge tooltip and set aria-label accordingly.
Kei: On 2) change tooltip to 'Pin to compare (session)' and show an ephemeral banner: 'Pinned for this compare session' after pinning. use role=status so SRs hear it.
Renee: Also for compact mode the filter rail collapses to an icon with no count. users think filters cleared. We should show a tiny counter in the collapsed control: 'Filters (2)'.
Omar: Implementation idea: collapsed button keeps aria-expanded and accessible name including count: `aria-label=\"Expand filters, 2 selected\"`. announce toggle via aria-live when it changes.
Kei: For badges: propose a compact legend in the table header (help icon) that opens a small popover listing tier names and what they measure. Track opens with `catalog.legend.opened`.
Renee: Accessibility checklist from review: 1) Badge must have aria-label describing tier + metric. 2) Pin button must use aria-pressed and aria-label with model+version. 3) Collapsed filter toggle must be tabbable and announce counts.
a11y-bot: Quick checks: ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for small badge text/icons; avoid color-only cues; popover must be keyboard operable.
Omar: Next steps: Kei will update tooltip copy + ephemeral banner mock; Renee will add header legend mock in Figma; I'll add the aria props in the Badge and Pin components.
Kei: I'll drop the mock in ~2h and open a small PR after design review.
Renee: Thanks 44d aiming for a tiny unflagged rollout after QA.
